title: [Bug] GitHub connector missing from MCP list despite showing in settings
body:
**Bug Description**

  appear in the list at all.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: Apple_Terminal
- Version: 2.1.62
- Feedback ID: d3c522be-5548-4bf3-952f-d7fc728809bb
